global_attributes.keywords: BATHYMETRY/SEAFLOOR TOPOGRAPHY, DIGITAL ELEVATION/DIGITAL TERRAIN MODELS
global_attributes.license: The GEBCO Grid is placed in the public domain and may be used free of charge. Use of the GEBCO Grid indicates that the user accepts the conditions of use and disclaimer information: https://www.gebco.net/
global_attributes.source: The GEBCO_2026 Grid is the 2026 release of the  global bathymetric product published by the General Bathymetric Chart of the Oceans (GEBCO) and has been developed through the Nippon Foundation-GEBCO Seabed 2030 Project. This is a collaborative project between the Nippon Foundation of Japan and GEBCO. The Seabed 2030 Project aims to bring together all available bathymetric data to produce the definitive map of the world ocean floor and make it available to all.
global_attributes.summary: The GEBCO_2026 Grid is a continuous, global terrain model for ocean and land with a spatial resolution of 15 arc seconds.The grid uses as a base-map Version 2.8 of the SRTM15+ data set (Tozer et al, 2019). This data set is a fusion of land topography with measured and estimated seafloor topography. It is augmented with gridded bathymetric data sets developed as part of the Nippon Foundation-GEBCO Seabed 2030 Project.
global_attributes.title: The GEBCO_2026 Grid - a continuous terrain model for oceans and land at 15 arc-second intervals
